name: Hush
description:
Focus & Screen Privacy. Blur, dim & hide icons.

Hush hides everything on your Mac except what you’re working. Icons, wallpaper, other apps -  all behind a clean blur. One hotkey, and the noise is gone. 

Great for focusing, privacy in public place, or sharing your screen without showing your messy desktop. 

Free to download: Desktop Mode is free forever. Try everything free for 5 days - then one purchase unlocks it all. No subscription, ever.

Desktop Mode (free forever)
That pre-call panic when you realize your desktop is showing? Gone. One tap and your wallpaper, icons, and widgets are hidden behind a clean overlay. Pick a blur, a color, or drop in your own background image.

Active Window Mode (Pro)
Blur everything except the window you're working in. Or switch to Selected Apps and pick a few that stay visible - Cmd+Tab to a new one and it's added automatically. Your brain stops wandering because there's nothing to wander to.

Cursor Focus Mode (Pro)
Everything dims. A clear circle follows your cursor like a flashlight. Scroll to resize. Feels cinematic - perfect for presentations and demos where you want eyes on one thing.
Hide the Dock and menu bar too if you really want to disappear into your work.


SCREEN SHARING WITHOUT THE ANXIETY
You know the moment. Someone says "share your screen" and you suddenly see your desktop through their eyes. Hush catches this - it auto-activates the second you start sharing in Zoom, Meet, Teams, or anything else. When the call ends, it quietly turns off. You never think about it.

And forget the "share one window, stop sharing, pick another, reshare" dance. Share your full screen, pick the apps that stay visible, switch freely.
Your audience sees what you meant to show them. Nothing else.

WHAT'S IN IT
- Desktop, Active Window, Selected Apps, and Cursor Focus modes
- Auto-detect screen sharing (Zoom, Meet, Teams, Discord, anything)
- Cmd+Tab auto-add so switching apps just works
- Customizable global hotkey
- Adjustable blur intensity
- Dimming tint and frost texture
- Custom background images
- Per-display control for multi-monitor setups
- Mission Control toggle
- Prevents display sleep during presentations
- Launches at login
- 24 languages
- Lives in the menu bar, no Dock icon clutter

WHO IT'S FOR
Anyone who's ever panicked before sharing their screen. Anyone whose brain runs off the moment they see a notification. Designers, developers, teachers, streamers, people who just want to finish one thing without 12 windows yelling at them.

PRICING
- Free: Desktop Mode, forever.
- Hush Pro: one-time purchase unlocks all modes. Try everything free for 5 days. No subscription.

PRIVACY
No data collection. No accounts. No analytics. Everything happens on your Mac.

REQUIREMENTS
- macOS Sonoma or later
- Screen Recording permission (required to render the blur - nothing is recorded or transmitted)
